title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression + quality gating CI hook and metrics integration
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hook that enforces quality gates; integrate eval metrics export to CI artifacts for dashboarding.
body:
Motivation: We need stronger per-prompt regression checks in CI to catch prompt-set quality drops earlier and to make evaluation metrics available to downstream dashboards. This PR adds a CI hook that runs the eval-harness against a configured prompt-set, evaluates per-prompt metrics (accuracy/consistency/bleu-like scores and model confidence deltas), and fails the job when thresholds are breached. It also uploads a compact metrics artifact for the observability pipeline and provides a toggle for canary-only runs.

What this change does (summary):
- New CI job definition: .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt-ci.yml (invoked as part of PR checks and optional nightly runs).
- eval/harness/ci_hook.py: lightweight runner that executes prompt-set tests, computes per-prompt deltas vs baseline, and enforces configured gates.
- eval/harness/metrics_exporter.py: emits summarized CSV/JSON artifacts with per-prompt metrics and a graph-friendly sampling of token-level statistics.
- tests/eval/test_ci_hook.py: unit + integration tests mocking small prompt-sets.
- docs/eval/ci-hooks.md: usage, configuration examples, gate tuning guidance.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement CI runner and gate logic
- [x] Metrics artifact schema and uploader
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Docs and runbook for tuning thresholds
- [x] Added Linear tickets to track follow-ups

Notes on usage/config: The CI hook looks for eval_config/per_prompt_gates.yml in-repo (defaults provided). Per-prompt gates are expressed as relative drop thresholds and absolute minimums, with an allowlist for noisy prompts. The job supports a --canary flag to only run on canary branch or for specific reviewers to reduce noise. The metrics artifact is published as eval-per-prompt-metrics.json and is consumed by the metrics ingestion job in observability-pack for dashboarding and regression alerting.
commits_summary:
3 commits:
- Add CI workflow and basic runner (ci hook + exporter)
- Implement gate logic, add tests and baseline fixtures
- Docs and examples, tune thresholds based on internal benchmarks
review_comments: Priya: Suggested tightening the default gate for generation-consistency by 2%. Jordan: Asked for clearer failure messages and a non-exit code path to upload artifacts even on failure. Luis: Requested we add an opt-out label for large PRs to avoid long eval runs. Author (Maya): Addressed comments; added more verbose logs, ensured artifacts are uploaded before exit, and added `skip-eval` PR label support.
ci_checks: Initial run: failed (timeout on nightly matrix). Second run: failures in flaky test fixed by mocking random seed. Final run: all checks passed (lint, unit tests, integration small, workflows validation, metrics upload). Performance: avg run time (small prompt-set) ~ 3m 40s; recommend canary-only by default.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash-merge after approvals from Jordan and Priya. Post-merge actions: kicked off observability ingestion job to verify artifact schema; created follow-up Linear tasks ENG-7234 (increase prompt-set coverage), ENG-7240 (add RBAC for metrics artifacts).
post_merge_notes: Monitoring: enabled a 48h watch on regression-alerting dashboard and set a temporary 10% higher threshold for first week to reduce false positives. Ops: Documented rollback by disabling the eval-per-prompt CI workflow and removing the per_prompt_gates.yml file in repo root.
ephemeral_testing_notes: Local quick-start: `python eval/harness/ci_hook.py --prompt-set tests/fixtures/sample_prompts --baseline fixtures/baseline_v2025_10 --upload-artifact ./out.json`. Use `--dry-run` to only compute metrics without failing the process.
